title: Making Pancakes
text:
Pancakes are easy to make. You need flour, eggs, milk, and sugar. First, mix the flour and the sugar in a big bowl. Then add the eggs and the milk.

Heat a pan and put a little butter in it. Pour a small amount of mix into the pan. Cook it for two minutes, then turn it over. Your pancakes are ready when they are golden brown.

questions.text: What do you need to make pancakes?
How long do you cook the pancake before you turn it over?
Why do you put butter in the pan?
options: To stop the pancake from sticking

questions.text: What is the main purpose of this passage?
options: To teach how to make pancakes
To tell a story about a family
To explain how to grow flour

paragraph_translations: Los panqueques son fáciles de hacer. Necesitas harina, huevos, leche y azúcar. Primero, mezcla la harina y el azúcar en un tazón grande. Luego añade los huevos y la leche.

Calienta una sartén y pon un poco de mantequilla en ella. Vierte una pequeña cantidad de la mezcla en la sartén. Cocínala durante dos minutos y luego dale la vuelta. Tus panqueques están listos cuando estén dorados.
